title: GradingTasksResponse
description: A batch's tasks for the calling reader (GET /v1/grading/batches/{batch_id}/tasks), in THE CALLER'S seeded order (see `GradingBatch`), each carrying the caller's own verdict or null and never another reader's. An admin who is not a reader gets the tasks in batch order with `reader: null` and `verdict: null` on every task (plus `reader_verdicts`/`adjudication` once the batch is not `open`). Unpaginated: a read is ≤ a few hundred tasks and the UI wants the whole order.

reader.description: The calling reader's resolved subject — the order is theirs — or null for an admin who is not a reader (batch order).
